Capstone project. Presented at CIMA'26.

Hello Hope

AI-based text, voice and chat for emotional support

Hello Hope is a web app where college students can talk through how they feel, check in on their mood and try short relaxation exercises. It also helps them book a session with a mental health professional.

What it does

  • AI support chat with text and voice replies
  • Self-assessment for depression, stress, anxiety and mindfulness, with a score breakdown and suggestions
  • Mood tracker with daily notes and a trend chart
  • Relaxation center with guided breathing and recommended exercises
  • Sign up, sign in and a profile that personalizes the experience

What I built

  • Real-time text and voice responses through the OpenAI API
  • User login and authentication, with user data stored in PostgreSQL
  • Reusable, responsive UI components in React
  • API response handling with basic error handling for a smoother experience
  • React.js
  • Node.js
  • OpenAI API
  • PostgreSQL
  • Android
